# Live-Friction Audit — Champion Strategy (`orb_atr`)

**Generated by:** `tools/audit_champion_live.py` + code audit of `tools/aggressive_optimizer.py`
**Data:** 11 pairs M5, 2022-09-11 → 2026-09-11 (full 4-year set)
**Status: REVISED 2026-09-12 (session 7).** The first revision of this document
(section 5) estimated live P&L at ~$135–180/mo by layering costs on top of the
old simulator. That estimate is now **superseded**: the simulator bugs were
fixed in code and the strategy re-run end-to-end. The fixed-model results are
materially worse and change the decision.

---

## 1. Bugs found in the champion code path — ALL NOW FIXED

| # | Bug | Old behaviour | Fix (in `aggressive_optimizer.py`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Same-bar target/stop ambiguity booked as WIN (target checked before stop) | ~4.6% of old trades, ~13.5% of correctly-filled trades resolved by unknowable intrabar path | `stop_first` knob: True=pessimistic, False=optimistic, None=deterministic 50/50 coin (new default) |
| B2 | Limit fills assumed with no re-touch check | 11.5% of signals never re-touch the level; they carried **26.7% of P&L, 364/369 winners** (pure adverse selection) | `require_touch=True` default: unfilled signal → no trade; exit scan starts at the fill bar |
| B3 | One-position rule violated | Up to 2 overlapping positions on 249/1045 days (The5ers allows ONE order/position account-wide) | Chronological scheduling, single `slot_busy_until`; unfilled limit blocks its session slot |
| B4 | Pip values frozen at 2024-26 mids (USDCAD/USDCHF constants wrong: USDCAD@1.35 true pv $7.41 vs $9.80 assumed) | 2022-23 dollar risk oversized 10-17% | `day_pv()` computes pv from each day's real close (EURGBP via same-day GBPUSD) |

`legacy=True` on `run_backtest` reproduces the old numbers **to the cent**
($17,853.56 / 1812 trades / P1 12d — guarded by tests), so the entire delta
below is attributable to the four fixes, not noise. 14 new regression tests in
`tests/test_optimizer_fill_logic.py`; 185/185 pass.

## 3. Fixed-model results + realistic costs (raw account: 55% spread + $7/lot RT)

| Universe / config | Ambiguity | Total$ | Mth$ | PF | End state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-core T=2.5 RB=6 | optimistic | +5,172 | $104 | 1.57 | survives (P1 22d) |
| 3-core T=2.5 RB=6 | **coin 50/50** | −250 by trade 165 | — | 0.81 | **BUST** |
| 3-core T=3.0 RB=8 | optimistic | +4,152 | $83 | 1.39 | survives |
| 3-core T=3.0 RB=8 | coin 50/50 | −260 by trade 144 | — | 0.79 | **BUST** |
| 11-pair T=3.0 RB=8 | optimistic | +1,041 | $21 | 1.08 | breakeven |
| 11-pair T=3.0 RB=8 | coin 50/50 | −258 by trade 195 | — | 0.85 | **BUST** |
| + stop slippage (any) | any | — | — | ≤1.0 | bust / breakeven at best |

Why costs bite so hard: the 0.25×ATR stops are **2–4.5 pips**; round-trip cost
is **$4–6.5 per trade ≈ 40–65% of the $10 risk unit**. The edge cannot clear
its own microstructure fees unless the intrabar path breaks favourably
(optimistic bound) on the three core pairs.

## 4. Verdict and required next step

1. **The strategy's true expectancy is not identifiable from M5 data.** 13.5%
   of filled trades are decided by intrabar path (fill bar spanning stop and
   target); the bounds span [account bust, +$220/mo]. Every number in between
   is defensible; the coin-flip mid bound with real costs is **negative**.
2. **Do not take this config live on the M5 evidence.** Requirement before any
   demo/live risk: re-validate entries, ambiguity bars and exits on **tick or
   1-minute data** (the repo already has `tools/tick_signal_builder.py` and the
   progress log asks for Eightcap tick data — this is now mandatory, not
   optional).
3. If tick validation confirms the optimistic path: trade **3-core only
   (GBPJPY, EURJPY, XAUUSD)**, raw-spread account, T=2.5R RB=6 variant
   (best survivor, PF 1.57 with costs). If it confirms the coin/pessimistic
   path: discard the configuration.
4. Design lever for a redesign: widen stops (≥0.5–1.0×ATR or ≥1×M5 bar range)
   so same-bar collisions and cost share shrink; re-optimize ONLY on the fixed
   simulator; keep the one-slot scheduler.

---

## 5. Superseded first-revision estimate (kept for the record)

The first revision of this audit ran on the **buggy** simulator (instant fills,
target-first ambiguity, overlapping positions): baseline $17,854 (PF 3.55,
$359/mo, P1 12d); "realistic" variants $6.6–10.9K; conclusion then was
"~$135–180/mo live". That conclusion was too optimistic because it still
booked the 369 never-fillable winners and the optimistic ambiguity bound. See
git history (`e3e6ccd`) for that version.
